crossRefs.note: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and…

translations.web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
translations.bsb: Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.
translations.kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
translations.asv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.
